name: Outline
tagline: Fast team wiki and knowledge base
description: Outline is a modern team wiki with a Slack-era feel: fast search, collaborative editing, and a clean editor. It is self-hostable, supports realtime collaboration, and stores everything in Postgres. A serious option for teams that outgrew Notion or Confluence and want data ownership.
highlights: Instant search across the whole workspace
curatorNote: Outline is the wiki that feels like a product, not a chore. Fast search alone is worth the switch for teams drowning in scattered docs.
